arguments.heading: What happened at the argument
paragraphs: Jeffrey Fisher argued the Fifth Amendment prohibits using silence against a suspect.
He stated that specific facts do not justify an exception to this rule.
Justice Breyer asked where the line lies between silence and invocation.
Justice Ginsburg cited a case where silence was not an invocation.

sections.heading: What this case is about
paragraphs: This case tests whether the Fifth Amendment protects silence during noncustodial police interviews. The Court must decide if prosecutors may comment on a suspect's refusal to answer questions.
